shortDescription: HDFC Bank NSE:HDFCBANK shares were flat in pre-open trade on Monday as investors digested the news that CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan will not seek reappointment when his current term ends in late October.The shares, which were about 40% foreign-owned as at June-end, have fallen 27% so far this year.
